reviews.text: I am very displeased with the work of Ace Handyman. I told the front desk exactly what happened and needed to be done. I had a pipe burst and my entire ceiling is ruined. ServicePro only came in, cut a few pieces out and dried out the area. Now, I've been through floods before. The best way to tackle water damage is to replace all of the drywall. The front desk said she could have someone start pretty quick. He never called me and showed up an hour late to my house. Colt is not a professional drywall man. When I informed him of what I wanted to be done. He said something about "rednecking it". I was appalled.  Then after 7 hours of work, he only put up 1 sheet of drywall. I could have done that. He patched up holes when I explicitly said I needed the rest of the drywall down. If my job was too difficult then your company should have turned me down. The other handyman did the same mistake and just patched the holes. I understood the finish wouldn't be professionally done. But now I have to replace everything again because water damage began to appear once the mud dried. I just wasted 2k, my time and my effort on this company. I'm beyond upset. I will never use this company again and I will be informing everyone I know about this. I feel robbed. Over 2k for unprofessional work. Your company should send someone out to quote before accepting.
